ns2:section.sectionText: This is an online course taught on Compass for non-NRES majors. There are no classroom sessions. However, you must be present for evening exams at 7:00 pm on April 2 and April 16, 2013, as well as a final exam during finals week. Further information at: http://go.illinois.edu/NRES102. No waiting list will be maintained and no closed course overrides will be granted for this course.There will be no exceptions, so please do NOT contact the instructor or the department to inquire.
